name: delete_destination
description:
Deletes the Destination for the specified `destination_id`. Once deleted, a Destination cannot be restored, and Hevo also deletes every Pipeline that replicates data into it, along with the Sources that those Pipelines were created with. The tables in your Destination are not deleted. Drop them yourself if you no longer need the data.

If any Pipeline replicates data into the Destination, the request returns a `409` listing those Pipelines, unless you set the `confirm_override` query parameter to `true`. If no Pipeline replicates data into the Destination, Hevo deletes it without asking for confirmation.

Deletion does not complete immediately. The response returns the Destination in status `DELETING`. Once the request is accepted, the Destination is no longer visible through the API, and retrieving or deleting it again returns a `404`.

Refer to [Deleting a Destination](/reference/deleting-a-destination#deleting-the-destination) for more information about what is deleted along with the Destination.
consequence: Deletes this Destination and every Pipeline that loads data into it. This action cannot be undone.
title: Delete Edge Destination

parameters.description: Unique identifier of the Destination, as returned by the [List All Destinations](/reference/get_api-v2-destinations) endpoint.
parameters.name: destination_id

parameters.description: Set this to `true` to delete the Destination along with the Pipelines that replicate data into it.
parameters.name: confirm_override

code.description: Status of the API call. Returns `Accepted` when the delete request is accepted.

message.description: Description of the action that Hevo performed.

data.description: Details of the Destination that is being deleted. Its `status` is `DELETING`.

name.description: Name of the Destination in Hevo.

connector_id.description: Identifier of the connector that loads data into this Destination. This is the `connector_id` value that the Destination was created with. For example, _snowflake_.

type.description: Type of the Destination. This is the `type` value that the Destination was created with. For example, _SNOWFLAKE_.

status.description:
Current status of the Destination.

A Destination that has been deleted is no longer returned by any endpoint.

x-enumDescriptions.CREATED: The Destination is ready to receive data.
x-enumDescriptions.FAILED: Hevo created the Destination but could not complete its setup.

config.description: Configuration settings of the Destination, with credentials masked. The settings returned depend on the connector. Refer to [Read the Connector Configuration](/reference/creating-destinations-with-hevo-api#step-1-read-the-connector-configuration) for more information about the settings that each connector accepts.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the Destination was created, in Unix epoch time (in milliseconds).

created_by.description: Email address of the user who created the Destination.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the Destination was last updated, in Unix epoch time (in milliseconds).

updated_by.description: Email address of the user who last updated the Destination.
